points.quote: `base/` holds foundation utilities that work on any platform. ... basic DOM and widget helpers.
`platform/` holds platform services and the dependency-injection infrastructure. ... It is independent of any particular editor or workbench UI.
`editor/` is the Monaco text editor: model, view, language features, syntax highlighting and editing behavior.
`workbench/` is the main application shell for desktop and web. ... `browser/` has the core UI: parts, layout and actions.
`code/` is the Electron main-process entry and implementation.
`server/` is the server-side entry, used for remote and web hosting.
`base` depends on nothing above it. `platform` may use `base`. `editor` may use `base` and `platform`. `workbench` may use `base`, `platform` and `editor`.
`api/` has the extension host and the implementation of the VS Code extension API.
